measurement.observed_useful_span_definition: last_meaningful_progress_at - substantive_work_started_at; diagnostic only until internal evidence-gap audit passes
measurement.continuous_progress_rule: Only spans whose durable evidence-point gaps all satisfy the <=120s contract may be promoted to counted useful span.
measurement.window_useful_coverage_definition: sum of evidenced useful intervals inside the intended observation window, excluding unexplained gaps and known idle/waiting
measurement.target_operating_model: >=840s evidenced useful coverage per intended 900s evaluation window
measurement.scheduler_migration_note: Fixed-quarter feasibility arithmetic is historical. Rolling samples measure actual due, observed wake, work evidence, final rearm, subsequent wake, and unexplained gaps.
measurement.signed_delivery_offset_definition: worker_observed_at - expected_wake_at; negative means early invocation, positive means late invocation. Never clamp early observations to zero.

meaningful_outputs: signed scheduler delivery offset semantics added
active_turn_observation.note: Run context timestamp is second-precision and reports invocation 35s before durable expected due. Treat as signed scheduler jitter/boundary behavior, not negative latency and not evidence of useful work before the first durable mutation. This is not a completed utilization sample.

latest_completed_turn.reason: Valid historical fixed-quarter evidence retained for comparison, but not counted as rolling-lifecycle acceptance sample.

latest_diagnosis.evidence: Two observed rolling reentries now span approximately +64s late and -35s early relative to durable expected due. Scheduler boundary behavior must therefore be measured as signed offset; startup overhead remains a separate interval from observed invocation to first substantive durable progress.
latest_diagnosis.secondary_risk: Two boundary observations are insufficient to characterize distribution or prove >=840s useful coverage. Need completed rolling samples with <=120s evidence gaps and no stale rollback/duplicate overlap.

next_corrective_experiment.hypothesis: Separating signed scheduler delivery offset, startup overhead, active useful span, and abrupt-loss recovery will identify the dominant source of P0 coverage loss without misclassifying early wakes.
next_corrective_experiment.change: For each rolling wake record expected due, observed invocation, first substantive durable progress, natural evidence points, final rearm, and next observed wake as distinct timestamps; preserve signed scheduler offset and do not infer missing coverage.
next_corrective_experiment.success_signal: Collect enough complete rolling windows to isolate dominant loss and achieve at least three valid completed rolling samples with mean evidenced useful coverage >=840s.
